paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the average overall performance of various Large Language Models (LLMs) across two Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization (KGDS) patterns. The vertical axis represents the "Average Performance (%)", ranging from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis contains categories representing different LLMs, which are not explicitly labeled but are distinguished by different colors. The bars in the chart represent the average performance of each LLM, with values ranging from 29.44% to 68.66%; the highest value is 68.66%, and the lowest is 29.44%. The bars are grouped into three tiers based on their performance, with Tier-1 having values between 61 and 69, Tier-2 between 53 and 56, and Tier-3 between 29 and 37, as indicated by the caption. The bars within each tier are not sorted in a specific order, and some bars are colored differently, but no specific visual emphasis is observed. The chart provides a visual representation of the performance of different LLMs across the KGDS patterns.
